name: serif
description: A minimalist, typography-first FSE (Full Site Editing) theme tailored for writers, journalists, and designers.

scripts.test:a11y: bunx playwright test --config tests/e2e-pw/playwright.config.ts accessibility variations
scripts.build: bun run build:css && bun run build:js
scripts.makepot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=/var/www/html/wp-content/themes/serif wp i18n make-pot . languages/serif.pot --domain=serif --exclude=node_modules,vendor,tests,assets,build,scripts,plugins,serif-child
scripts.update-po: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=/var/www/html/wp-content/themes/serif wp i18n update-po languages/serif.pot languages/
scripts.makemo: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=/var/www/html/wp-content/themes/serif wp i18n make-mo languages/
